title: How to Protect Against Increased Viral Spread in Winter
speaker: VOA Learning English

sentences.en: Knowing what these infections are and how they spread can help us avoid them.
sentences.zh: 了解这些感染是什么以及它们是如何传播的,可以帮助我们避免感染。

sentences.en: The Associated Press has listed some things anyone can do to keep healthy and to know more about these infections: Cold, flu, or COVID?
sentences.zh: 美联社列出一些任何人都可以做的事情 来保持健康 并了解更多关于这些感染: 冷、流感或COVID?

sentences.en: Some signs, or symptoms, of a cold, the flu, COVID-19 or norovirus are similar.
sentences.zh: 一些感冒、流感、COVID-19或诺罗病毒的症状或症状相似。

sentences.en: This can make it hard to know what is making us sick.
sentences.zh: 这会使我们很难知道是什么让我们生病。

sentences.en: However, some symptoms are unmistakable.
sentences.zh: 然而,有些症状是明确的。

sentences.en: Norovirus spreads through polluted food, water and surfaces, including the skin.
sentences.zh: 诺罗病毒通过被污染的食物、水和表面,包括皮肤传播。

sentences.en: The virus causes vomiting , diarrhea , and stomach pain.
sentences.zh: 病毒导致呕吐、腹泻和胃痛。

sentences.en: The sickness can last for about one to three days.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病可以持续一至三天。

sentences.en: The common cold can be caused by several different kinds of viruses and can include several symptoms.
sentences.zh: 常见的寒冷可能由几种不同的病毒造成,并可能包括几种症状。

sentences.en: These include a runny nose, congestion , cough , sneezing , and pain in the throat, head and other parts of the body.
sentences.zh: 这些症状包括流鼻涕、堵塞、咳嗽、打喷嚏、喉咙、头部和身体其他部位疼痛。

sentences.en: It can also cause higher than normal body temperature, or a fever.
sentences.zh: 也可能导致高于正常体温或发烧。

sentences.en: The common cold usually lasts less than a week.
sentences.zh: 普通感冒通常持续不到一周。

sentences.en: The flu is caused by influenza viruses that are always changing.
sentences.zh: 流感是由流感病毒引起的,而流感病毒总是在变化。

sentences.en: Infection leads to fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, body aches , headaches and feeling tired.
sentences.zh: 感染导致发烧、咳嗽、喉咙痛、鼻子发痒、身体疼痛、头痛和感到疲惫。

sentences.en: Flu symptoms usually hit more quickly than cold symptoms.
sentences.zh: 流感症状的发作速度通常比寒冷症状更快。

sentences.en: They can last from a few days to two weeks.
sentences.zh: 它们可以持续几天到两周。

sentences.en: COVID-19 can cause fever, chills , cough, congestion, tiredness and throat and head pain.
sentences.zh: COVID-19可造成发烧、寒冷、咳嗽、拥堵、疲惫、喉咙和头痛。

sentences.en: Other signs of COVID are the loss of smell or taste, difficulty breathing, nausea, or vomiting.
sentences.zh: COVID的其他迹象是失去气味或品味、呼吸困难、恶心或呕吐。

sentences.en: The sickness can last for several days. The respiratory syncytial virus, or RSV , can make people sick for one or two weeks.
sentences.zh: 这种疾病可以持续数天。呼吸同步病毒(RSV)可以使人们生病一两个星期。

sentences.en: The signs include runny nose, congestion, coughing, sneezing, breathing problems, fever, and a loss of appetite .
sentences.zh: 这些症状包括鼻涕、堵塞、咳嗽、打喷嚏、呼吸问题、发烧和食欲丧失。

sentences.en: Wash your hands So how can we avoid infections?
sentences.zh: 洗手,我们怎样才能避免感染?

sentences.en: Experts say people should wash their hands carefully and often with a cleanser such as soap.
sentences.zh: 专家说人们应该小心洗手 经常用肥皂等清洁剂洗手

sentences.en: Clean hands are very important to reducing the spread of norovirus, colds, flu and COVID-19.
sentences.zh: 干净的手对减少诺罗病毒、感冒、流感和COVID-19的传播非常重要。

sentences.en: The United States Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) says this is especially true after using the bathroom, eating or preparing food.
sentences.zh: 美国疾病控制和预防中心(疾病防治中心)说,使用卫生间、吃饭或准备食物后尤其如此。

sentences.en: Make sure you take enough time to wash your hands.
sentences.zh: 确保你有足够的时间洗手。

sentences.en: It should take at least 20 seconds to complete the job.
sentences.zh: 至少要20秒才能完成这份工作

sentences.en: If you do not have soap and water available, cleansers called hand sanitizers are a good substitute.
sentences.zh: 如果你没有肥皂和水, 清洁剂叫做洗手剂 是一个很好的替代品。

sentences.en: The sanitizer must be at least 60 percent alcohol to be effective against most of these viruses.
sentences.zh: 麻醉剂必须至少达到60%的酒精 才能有效对抗大部分的病毒

sentences.en: An exception is norovirus which requires a stronger sanitizer.
sentences.zh: 一个例外是诺罗病毒 需要更强的消毒剂

sentences.en: Cleaning surfaces can remove viruses To avoid norovirus, you must immediately clean surfaces that have come in contact with infected food or bodily fluids.
sentences.zh: 清洁表面可以清除病毒 避免诺罗病毒 你必须立即清除接触过感染食物或体液的表面

sentences.en: The CDC advises disinfecting things with a chlorine bleach solution or one of the products listed on the Environmental Protection Agency website .
sentences.zh: 疾控中心建议用氯漂白剂或环境保护署网站所列产品之一消毒。

sentences.en: Do not forget to wash any clothing that has come in contact with vomit or other bodily waste.
sentences.zh: 不要忘记清洗任何与呕吐物或其他身体废物接触的衣物。

sentences.en: Use hot water and soap. Then, wash your hands again.
sentences.zh: 用热水和肥皂 然后再洗手

sentences.en: With colds and flu, it is best to repeatedly clean surfaces that are touched or used often.
sentences.zh: 在感冒和流感发生后,最好反复清理经常被触动或使用的表面。

sentences.en: These include doorknobs, light switches, kitchen workspaces, children’s playthings, cellphones and other objects around the home.
sentences.zh: 其中包括门把手、灯开关、厨房工作空间、儿童玩物、手机和周围的其他物品。

sentences.en: Use household cleaning products that contain soap or detergent and follow up with a sanitizer.
sentences.zh: 使用含有肥皂或洗涤剂的家庭清洁产品,并采用清洁剂进行后续处理。

sentences.en: The CDC has more advice on how to clean .
sentences.zh: 疾控中心对如何清理有更多的建议。

sentences.en: COVID-19 spreads through the air in small drops and particles.
sentences.zh: COVID-19在空气中以小滴和微粒的形式扩散。

sentences.en: The CDC says there is low risk of getting the virus from surfaces.
sentences.zh: 疾控中心说,从表面获得病毒的风险较低。

sentences.en: Keeping your hands off your face can keep viruses out Viruses can spread through talking, coughing and sneezing, so cover your mouth with a tissue when you sneeze or cough.
sentences.zh: 把手从脸上拿开 病毒会通过说话、咳嗽和打喷嚏传播 所以打喷嚏或咳嗽时用纸巾遮住嘴

sentences.en: Then, wash your hands. Do not touch your face.
sentences.zh: 那就洗手,别碰你的脸

sentences.en: If you have viruses on your unwashed hands and touch your face, eyes or nose, they can get into your body.
sentences.zh: 如果你有病毒 在你的未洗手手 触摸你的脸,眼睛或鼻子, 他们可以进入你的身体。

sentences.en: Your likelihood of getting sick will increase.
sentences.zh: 你生病的可能性会增加

sentences.en: Consider a vaccine (if there is one) You might consider a vaccine if one is available.
sentences.zh: 考虑一种疫苗(如果有的话),如果有疫苗,你可以考虑一种疫苗。

sentences.en: Updated COVID-19 vaccines are available.
sentences.zh: 可获得最新的COVID-19疫苗。

sentences.en: Yearly flu shots for people 6 months and older are also available.
sentences.zh: 6个月和6个月以上的人每年也可接种流感疫苗。

sentences.en: For adults 60 and older or people who are pregnant, you might want to get the RSV vaccine .
sentences.zh: 对于60岁及60岁以上的成年人或怀孕的人,你可能想要获得RSV疫苗。

sentences.en: There is no vaccine for norovirus or the common cold.
sentences.zh: 没有诺罗病毒或普通寒冷的疫苗。

sentences.en: Another way to keep your defenses against viruses up: Rest Your immune system may not work as well if you are lacking enough sleep, water or are experiencing high levels of tension.
sentences.zh: 另一种防止病毒的方法是:休息你的免疫系统,如果睡眠不足、缺水或出现高度紧张状况,可能无法正常工作。

sentences.en: Rest. Sleep . And drink enough water. Stay at home If you do get sick, you can take a test to find out if you have COVID-19 or influenza.
sentences.zh: 休息 睡觉 喝足够的水 呆在家里 如果你生病了 你可以做个测试

sentences.en: It is important to know if you have a virus that could be treated with available medicines.
sentences.zh: 重要的是要知道,你是否有一种可以用现有药物治疗的病毒。

sentences.en: The drug Paxlovid treats COVID-19. Tamiflu is used to treat flu.
sentences.zh: 大同协会治疗COVID-19,塔菲鲁治疗流感。

sentences.en: Above all, if you have symptoms of any of these sicknesses, stay at home and away from other people.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是,如果你有这些疾病的任何症状, 呆在家里,远离其他人。

sentences.en: This will help stop the spread of viruses.
sentences.zh: 这将有助于阻止病毒的传播。

sentences.en: To treat a cold, flu or COVID-19, rest and drink fluids.
sentences.zh: 治疗感冒、流感或COVID-19,休息和饮用液体。

sentences.en: You can take pain medicine to lower a fever or to ease pain.
sentences.zh: 你可以吃止痛药来降低发烧或减轻疼痛。

sentences.en: Humidifier machines, which increase the amount of water in the air, can also help ease symptoms.
sentences.zh: 湿化机增加空气中的水量,也有助于缓解症状。

sentences.en: There is no medication for norovirus. You need to replace fluids lost because of the sickness .
sentences.zh: 没有治疗诺罗病毒的药物,你需要更换因疾病而流失的液体。

sentences.en: Drink as much water and other liquids as possible.
sentences.zh: 尽量多喝水和其他液体。

sentences.en: Seek medical help if you notice you have a dry mouth and throat, are not expelling liquid waste easily, or feel dizzy when standing.
sentences.zh: 如果你注意到你的嘴和喉咙很干,就寻求医疗帮助,不会轻易地将液体废物排出,或站立时感到头晕。

sentences.en: I’m Caty Weaver. And I’m Mario Ritter Jr.
sentences.zh: 我是Caty Weaver, 我是Mario Ritter Jr.

sentences.en: The Associated Press produced this report.
sentences.zh: 美联社编写了这份报告。

sentences.en: Caty Weaver adapted it for VOA Learning English.
sentences.zh: Caty Weaver为VOA学习英语改编了它。
